_about: The known debt of the UI checks (scripts/ci/ui-checks.mjs), written down once. Every entry is a COUNT of offences per rule and file, with the reason and the slice that owes the fix. The count is a ratchet: one more offence than listed fails the check, and one fewer fails it too (lower the count), so the list only shrinks and an entry cannot outlive its cause. A file entry is a number, or {count, reason} when that file has a reason of its own. A rule with no entry here has no debt. node scripts/ci/ui-checks.mjs --counts prints the current numbers.

colour-built-at-runtime.reason: the impact meter ramp interpolates its stop colours at run time; it moves to color-mix on the band tokens (K:52, K:53).

style-px.reason: an inline style with a literal pixel size where the scale (var(--sp-*), var(--target)) exists (K:53).

class-undefined.reason: a string that starts with cl- and is not a class: a localStorage key, an element id, or a test-mount wrapper class that carries no style. The rule reads every cl- string; these stay and say so.

cl-btn-outside-button.reason: a button drawn by hand with the cl-btn classes instead of the Button part (K:87); ActionButton and Button become one part and these callers use it.

raw-form-control.reason: a raw input, select or textarea outside FormField (K:92): the auth pages, ArchiveDialog, TagPopover, the command bar and the collab blocks migrate to FormField, which injects the field id.

wall-clock.reason: a wall-clock read (Date.now() or new Date() with no argument) outside the injected clock (C:48, S:95): each moves to deps.now, and a duration uses performance.now.

bare-fetch.reason: a fetch( call outside the one request caller (C:55, K:93).

src/core/http/request-json.ts.reason: this is the one request caller: every other module calls it.

src/core/turn/wiring.ts.reason: the production default of the injected fetch implementation (opts.fetchImpl ?? fetch); the turn hands the gated primitive everything else.

src/features/auth/ui/AuthProvider.tsx.reason: the identity loader reads the Retry-After header of the response to decide how long to wait; the one request caller does not yet hand a refusal its headers.

src/features/coverage/client.tsx.reason: the CSV export reads the response as a file (the text of the body and its content-disposition header), which the JSON request caller does not carry.

src/ui/shell/GlobalErrorReporter.tsx.reason: the error reporter must not depend on the request caller whose failure it may be reporting; it posts with keepalive.

kit-fetch.reason: the kit calls the request caller (K:93): the collab blocks, the notices rail and the notifications list move to their features with the caller handed in.

kit-imports-feature.reason: the shell imports the auth provider, the identity types and the workspace state from features (K:93); the shell receives them as props or moves to a feature.

entity-in-string.reason: an HTML entity in a string.

src/features/obligations/extract/date-gr.reason: a pattern that matches   in captured HTML source, not text shown to a reader: it stays.

src/features/operations/ui/OperationsDet.reason: S:4 (CONFIRMED, P0): the not-written note is a string, so the customer reads the characters '. R2d writes the sentence in the typed copy table and this entry goes.

src/features/regulations/map/MapView.tsx.reason: Leaflet reads its attribution option as HTML, so the entity is decoded there: it stays.

src/features/research/ui/ResearchDetail..reason: S:4 (CONFIRMED, P0): the not-written note is a string, so the customer reads the characters '. R2d writes the sentence in the typed copy table and this entry goes.

http-error-message.reason: a driver or database message passed as the HttpError sentence (E14): typed sentences for the customer replace them.

src/core/http/parse.ts.reason: the sentence is the validation issue for the caller's own input, written for the caller; the typed parsers (R2a) replace it.

src/features/community/api/posts.ts.reason: the sentence comes from the project's own rpc (SQLSTATE 22023) and is written for the caller; R4a gives it a typed code.

supabase-error-unhandled.reason: a database read whose error is never looked at, so a failed read is treated as no row.

src/core/grounding/ground.ts.reason: the provenance status read after validation ignores its error: a failed read reports provenance null (C: grounding).

style-on-kit-part.reason: a feature restyles a kit part with `style` (K:48); the part gets a variant or the style moves to the stylesheet.

css-px-scale.reason: a literal pixel size in padding, margin, gap or font-size where the scale (var(--sp-*), var(--fs-*)) exists (K:53); base.css uses the spacing tokens nowhere.
